edges.effect_quant: The strongest quantitative studies point in a harmful direction, but the pooled magnitude varies across populations and methods.
edges.population: adults classified as metabolically healthy despite obesity
edges.mechanism: Even when glucose and lipids look acceptable at one time point, excess adiposity can still raise long-term risk through ectopic fat, inflammation, and later metabolic drift.
edges.summary: The anchor for this edge is the 2023 Opio meta analysis in Int J Obes (Lond), which suggests that metabolically healthy obesity tracks with higher risk or worse outcomes for all-cause mortality. Later papers point in much the same direction, so the live uncertainty is usually about effect size or which subgroups carry the signal most strongly.
edges.caveats: Residual confounding and reverse causation remain possible in some observational studies, so the main readout is direction and plausibility rather than one exact risk number.
